text: This report recommends that the name "Cavliere Gino Cucchi Lane" be approved to identify an existing public lane located north of St. Clair Avenue West, extending between Nairn Avenue and Earlscourt Avenue. Community Councils have delegated authority to decide street naming matters which comply with the City of Toronto Street Naming Policy.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Approved the name "Cavliere Gino Cucchi Lane" for an existing public lane located north of St. Clair Avenue West, extending between Nairn Avenue and Earlscourt Avenue.
